caption:
HOT MOCHA
Winters in Pune have already been dropping to record lows of 12 degrees even colder than the popular hill station nearby - Mahabaleshwar. 
This definitely deems the start of hot winter drinks and none beat this yummy hot mocha. Chocolate and Coffee are a match made in heaven!

Feel Free to message me in the tab below for any questions you may have :) 
Ingredients: 
1 tbsp cocoa powder
1 tbsp coffee
1 tbsp hot water
1 - 1.5 cups whole fat / slim milk OR Lactose Free OR Plant based milk works as well
1 tsp whipped cream
Having a frother is amazing but if you don’t a spoon works fine!
Optional: 
1 tsp sugar/stevia/jaggery
5-6 chocolate callets

Method: 
Start by heating your milk on a low flame. 
While the milk is heating, in a cup, add the cocoa, coffee and water and mix till well combined. 
Add in the hot milk and mix together.
Add in the chocolate callets at this point if using. 
Topped with whipped cream and serve piping hot :)
